# 1 Enoch Chapter 87 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 1 Enoch Chapter 87 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 87:1 — 'white figures' — identification of the archangels

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "four-white-figures" | Literal; the archangels appear as white beings |
| LOGOS | "four white figures" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "four white figures [the archangels]" | Adds identification in brackets |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS clean text; identification in SOPHIA notes. The Ge'ez has 'four white figures' without explicit identification. The identification as archangels is contextually certain (cf. 1 En 9:1; 40:9) but is commentary, not translation.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/EMET.

---

## 87:4 — 'bound it hand and foot' for a star

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "bound-it-hand-and-foot" | The star is personified; bound like a prisoner |
| LOGOS | "bound it hand and foot" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "bind it hand and foot" | Same action, slightly different phrasing |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three converge on 'bound it hand and foot.' The binding of a star 'hand and foot' is consistent with the personification of the Watchers as beings who have taken on embodied form. Cf. 1 En 10:4 where Azazel is also bound.

**Status:** Converged.

---

## 87:4 — 'horrible' vs. 'terrible' vs. 'terrifying' for the abyss

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "horrible" | Traditional English rendering of the Ge'ez term |
| LOGOS | "horrible" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "terrifying" | More visceral modern English |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted 'horrible' (LOGOS/EMET). 'Horrible' (from Latin horribilis) carries the connotation of hair-raising dread — appropriate for the place of angelic punishment. 'Terrifying' (PNEUMA) is more active and less archaic but less apt.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/EMET.

---
